title: Tangan Kiri Bawah Meja
genre: Malay calypso (Caribbean steel-pan calypso with Malay comic storytelling)
subject: a left-handed man at his girlfriend's mother's first Sunday lunch, forcing himself to eat nasi with his right hand while his left hides under the table, until the mother hands him the sambal with her own left hand and winks
caption: Malay calypso, Trinidadian steel-pan calypso two-feel with a lilting off-beat swing. Steel pan carrying the melody and hook, nylon-string acoustic guitar strumming on the off-beat, upright bass in a walking root-fifth pattern, congas and shaker, flute answering the vocal. Dry sunny live-band sound. Male tenor, bright mid register, cheeky storytelling sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, G major. Playful, cheeky mood. No electric guitar, no synth pads, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no reggae dub effects.
lyrics:
[Intro - steel pan, congas]
[Verse 1]
Hari Ahad aku datang rumah mak dia
Kemeja bergosok, buah tangan sebakul
Aku kidal dari kecil, makan guna kanan
Nasi jatuh atas riba, kuah menitik seluar
[Pre-Chorus]
Mak dia pandang, aku telan air liur
Ayam goreng bergoyang di hujung jari
[Chorus]
Tangan kiri bawah meja
Rahsia aku seorang
Tangan kanan kuis nasi
Makcik, jangan tengok, jangan tengok
[Verse 2]
Sambal belacan jauh di depan mak dia
Aku nak minta, tapi tangan mana satu
Tiba-tiba mangkuk datang, laju dari kiri
Mak dia hulur guna tangan kiri!
[Pre-Chorus]
Dia kenyit mata, aku hampir tersedak
Dia bisik, "Cikgu dulu ikat tangan aku"
[Chorus]
Dua tangan kiri bawah meja
Rahsia kami berdua
Tangan kanan kuis nasi
Makcik, hulur sambal lagi, hulur sambal
[Bridge - steel pan, flute]
Adik dia ketawa, ayah dia tak faham
Kami berdua makan sambil senyum
[Chorus]
Tangan kiri atas meja
Rahsia dah terbuka
Tangan kiri makan sendiri
Makcik, tambah nasi, tambah nasi
[Outro - steel pan]
